protocol: pre-registration §8 EXP-0048 locked style: seed 0 per regime, 4 LOBO folds, 5 policies, 6 budgets; cell = policy replay + 6 budget predictions; data load / episode build / hyper fits timed separately

M00.label: frozen v1_3 = v1_2.cfg_of(facets='all', guard=0) + normal pair + grid

limitations: Timing only; predictions are discarded and ep.score (Brier/ECE) is never called, so scoring time is excluded.
One seed per regime; R1 cost for other seeds is extrapolated from structural draw sizes.
Run under the shared 2-slot gate with 3 BLAS threads; another agent's job may share the CPU.
Inner-fold cells use nested hyperparameters; their per-cell cost is assumed equal to the LOBO cell of the same benchmark.
